text:
sam: heads-up I'm pulling off primary at 22:30 UTC, running late with a customer call. can someone take primary for the next 3h?

lucy: I can if you need, but I have a deployment at 23:15 — will be on call but might be busy for 10-15m during the push. happy to be primary if that window is okay. :+1:

maria: i can take primary until 01:00 UTC if lucy needs to do the deploy. i handled the kv-cache fallback last week so ping me for that runbook.

sam: thanks. maria can you be primary from now? aj can be secondary?

aj: yep i can be secondary. i'll watch for pager noise and handle paging escalations.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: PAGER -> high  latency on inference-hosts in us-west-2 (alert id: INC-2027-899). paging to primary/secondary. link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2027-899

maria: saw the bot, opening thread. quick customer-impact check: dashboards show increased p50 and p95 for text generation; 3 customers with errors above SLA (customer-ids: C-8792, C-1023, C-445).

lucy: are we seeing token drops or 503s?

maria: mostly 503s and some very long responses (timed out at 30s). stack traces point to gRPC timeouts on runtime nodes.

sam: runbook for grpc-timeouts -> /runbooks/runtime/grpc-timeout.md (pinning). quick pointers from runbook: 1) check node health 2) rotate runtime pool 3) apply short-term routing fallback to fallback-model-1.

aj: grabbing node-health now. `curl -s https://infra-api.local/nodes/us-west-2 | jq '.nodes[] | {id, status, cpu, mem}'`

aj: (after) two nodes showing OOM kills in last 10m: node-17 and node-21. suspect autoscaler thrash.

maria: good catch. mitigation plan: a) cordon node-17/21 from runtime pool b) scale up reserve pool by +2 GPUs c) enable routing fallback to smaller-quantized model variant.

lucy: i'll do (a) and (b) — cordoning now: `infractl node cordon node-17 node-21 --reason "OOM during burst"`

lucy: scaling reserve pool: `infractl pool scale reserve-usw2 --add-gpus 2 --timeout 5m`

oncall-bot: ACTION_LOG: cordon command accepted for node-17, node-21. pool-scale job queued (job id: job-3321).

aj: routing fallback: `redwoodctl route set --selector region=us-west-2 --fallback-model redwood-small-q8_0` (this will move new requests to smaller model while nodes recover)

maria: deployed fallback routing. monitoring p50/p95 and error rates.

sam: customer comms: @support please draft a short note for affected customers (C-8792, C-1023, C-445). say we're mitigating and expect improvement in ~10-15m.

support (via ops-bot): drafted and queued — subject: Temporary inference degradation in us-west-2. Will send once we hit 10% error reduction.

lucy: job-3321 completed, reserve pool +2 GPUs active. node-17 still restarting, node-21 healthy now.

amj: (typo) aj: nice.

aj: seeing error rate drop from 18% -> 6% over last 5m. p95 latency down by ~40%.

maria: great. next steps: 1) keep cordon until node-17 fully reprovisioned 2) run full postmortem checklist after shift 3) add an autoscaler protection rule to avoid immediate scale-down after OOM events (runbook link: /runbooks/autoscaler/protections.md)

sam: i'm back online briefly — thanks team. maria keep primary til 01:00?

maria: yes i'm on primary until 01:00. aj you're secondary. lucy will finish the deploy and then take normal rotation duties.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error-rate reduced to 6% (INC-2027-899). mitigations: cordon nodes, reserve scale +2, routing fallback.

sam: before we close thread quick checklist for handoff notes (paste into the handoff doc):
- primary: maria (until 01:00 UTC)
- secondary: aj
- cordoned nodes: node-17 (still restarting), node-21 (recovery ok)
- fallback: redwood-small-q8_0 active for us-west-2
- customer-impact: C-8792, C-1023, C-445; support draft queued
- followups: autoscaler protection rule, postmortem ticket INC-2027-899-pm

maria: copied into handoff doc and pinned to #incidents for the night shift. thanks :raised_hands:

lucy: one more note — if error rate creeps back above 12% revert routing fallback and open a full pool-rollback plan (runbook: /runbooks/runtime/rollback.md)

aj: watched alerts, no new pages in 18m. all good from me.

sam: awesome. handoff confirmed. maria you're primary. i'll be reachable but off the clock. good job team. :rocket:
